name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
about:

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Capital Small Finance Bank Limited (CSFBL), originally a local area bank, is now a full-fledged Small Finance Bank focused on middle-income customers. It offers secured lending products, including agriculture loans (Kisan Credit Cards, term loans), MSME & trading loans, mortgage/housing loans, corporate loans, and consumption loans. It avoids direct exposure to Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
